profiles.name: Mohd Hasnizan Harun
profiles.description: Mohd Hasnizan Harun represents Hulu Selangor, Selangor, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PAS member.

profiles.name: Zulkafperi Hanapi
profiles.description: Zulkafperi Hanapi represents Tanjong Karang, Selangor, in the Dewan Rakyat. An independent MP supporting the government under the reported confidence-and-supply agreement.
profiles.affiliation_note: Independent government support is distinct from membership of a political party. The 29 October agreement does not prove any subsequent parliamentary vote.

profiles.name: William Leong Jee Keen
profiles.description: William Leong Jee Keen represents Selayang, Selangor, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PKR member.

milestones.title: Support Supply Bill 2027 under the confidence-and-supply agreement
milestones.description: Signed the agreement to support the 2027 Supply Bill.
milestones.progress_note: Signing is confirmed; subsequent voting and budget passage were not verified.

milestones.title: Fund drainage improvements along Jalan Rawang FT01
milestones.description: The Rawang representative reported a roadside drain funded through William Leong’s parliamentary allocation to reduce standing water.
milestones.progress_note: The May 2025 report documents implementation by the constituency and road authorities. The separate nearly-80% figure covers nine road-safety locations and is not a completion metric for this drain.

methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise. Status is tied to its evidence snapshot and shared agency responsibility is explicit. Historical activity is not a live November performance measurement. Allocations, attendance, sales orders and unrelated programme ratios are not completion percentages. Additional research may extend this initial pass.
